name: TwoThing
description: Personal inventory: nested places (room › shelf › box), items with specs/images/stock levels, bulk-printed random QR label codes, and camera scanning for labels and manufacturer barcodes.

endpoints.name: listItems
endpoints.description: Search/filter items. `q` matches every term across name, label, specs, tags, part number and barcodes. `locationId` includes sub-places unless recursive=false.

code.description: Our printed label code (canonical, e.g. K7QM2X)

barcodes.description: Manufacturer EAN/UPC/QR payloads found on the product

endpoints.name: createItem
endpoints.description: Creates an item. 409 code_in_use if the label is already on something.

code.description: Label code (scanned/typed); must not be on another item or place

autoCode.description: Allocate a fresh pool code when `code` is empty

code.description: Our printed label code (canonical, e.g. K7QM2X)

barcodes.description: Manufacturer EAN/UPC/QR payloads found on the product

endpoints.name: getItem
endpoints.description: One item plus its recent activity.

code.description: Our printed label code (canonical, e.g. K7QM2X)

barcodes.description: Manufacturer EAN/UPC/QR payloads found on the product

endpoints.description: Partial update; changes are diffed into the activity log.

barcodes.description: Manufacturer EAN/UPC/QR payloads found on the product

endpoints.name: deleteItem
endpoints.description: Deletes an item (its label code becomes free again after the re-issue window).

endpoints.name: adjustQuantity
endpoints.description: Stock in/out: `delta` (+/-) or absolute `set`. Clamped at 0.

code.description: Our printed label code (canonical, e.g. K7QM2X)

barcodes.description: Manufacturer EAN/UPC/QR payloads found on the product

endpoints.name: moveItems
endpoints.description: Moves items into a place (null = unplaced). Used by scan put-away mode.

endpoints.name: listTags
endpoints.description: All tags with usage counts.

endpoints.name: listLocations
endpoints.description: Every place in tree (depth-first) order with direct + recursive item counts.

endpoints.name: createLocation
endpoints.description: Creates a place (room/shelf/box…).

kind.description: room | cabinet | shelf | rack | drawer | bin | box | organizer | bag | other

endpoints.name: getLocation
endpoints.description: A place with its direct children, direct items and activity.

code.description: Our printed label code (canonical, e.g. K7QM2X)

barcodes.description: Manufacturer EAN/UPC/QR payloads found on the product

endpoints.name: updateLocation
endpoints.description: Partial update. Re-parenting into own subtree → 400 cycle.

kind.description: room | cabinet | shelf | rack | drawer | bin | box | organizer | bag | other

endpoints.name: deleteLocation
endpoints.description: Deletes a place. Non-empty → 409 location_not_empty unless contents=parent (children + items move one level up).

endpoints.name: generateCodes
endpoints.description: Bulk-generates random (non-sequential) 6-char label codes for printing. A code is never handed out if it was generated in the last 7 days or is on any item/place.

endpoints.name: nextCode
endpoints.description: Allocates a single fresh code (same uniqueness rules), not tied to a print batch.

endpoints.name: listCodeBatches
endpoints.description: Print batches with how many of their codes are in use, plus pool totals.

endpoints.name: getCodeBatch
endpoints.description: Codes in a batch (for re-printing) and what each is used by.

endpoints.name: resolveCode
endpoints.description: Resolves anything scanned: our label (bare, dashed, TT: prefixed or a /c/CODE deep link) → item/location, a free label → free_code, a manufacturer barcode/QR → items carrying it.

endpoints.name: stats
endpoints.description: Dashboard: totals, per-category counts/value, low stock, recently added, favorites, recent activity.

endpoints.description: Activity log, newest first; `before` = id cursor.

endpoints.name: uploadImage
endpoints.description: Raw image body (content-type image/*, ≤ 8 MB). Returns the id to put in imageIds/imageId.

endpoints.name: getImage
endpoints.description: Image bytes (immutable cache).

endpoints.name: exportCsv
endpoints.description: All items as CSV (location as 'A > B > C' path, specs as k=v; pairs).

endpoints.name: importCsv
endpoints.description: Imports items from CSV (headers auto-mapped; missing location paths are created). dryRun validates only.
